title: Create shared input-validation.ts module with three validators
description: Create src-ts/mcp/input-validation.ts exporting three shared validation functions: validateStringLength(), safeResolveWorkspaceRoot(), validateWeight(). These are the foundation for all downstream security fixes.
action: Create src-ts/mcp/input-validation.ts exporting: (1) validateStringLength(value: string, maxLength: number, label: string): HttpResponse | null — returns jsonResponse({error: '...'}, 413) if value.length > maxLength, null otherwise; (2) safeResolveWorkspaceRoot(allowedRoot?: string): string — reads NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env, trims, resolves with path.resolve, checks resolved starts with path.resolve(allowedRoot ?? process.cwd()), throws Error on path traversal; (3) validateWeight(value: unknown, min: number, max: number, label: string): HttpResponse | null — checks Number.isFinite(value) && value >= min && value <= max, returns 400 on failure, null on pass

convergence.definition_of_done: Shared validation module compiles cleanly and exports three functions used by downstream tasks

files.change: Create new file with three exported validation functions

implementation: Import jsonResponse from './http-types.js' and path from 'node:path'

Implement validateStringLength(value: string, maxLength: number, label: string): HttpResponse | null — if value.length > maxLength, return jsonResponse({ error: `${label} exceeds maximum length of ${maxLength} characters` }, 413); otherwise return null

Implement safeResolveWorkspaceRoot(allowedRoot?: string): string — read NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE env, trim, if empty return allowedRoot ?? process.cwd(); otherwise path.resolve the trimmed value and check resolved.startsWith(path.resolve(allowedRoot ?? process.cwd())) — if false, throw new Error('Workspace path traversal detected')

Implement validateWeight(value: unknown, min: number, max: number, label: string): HttpResponse | null — if typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value), return jsonResponse({ error: `${label} must be a finite number` }, 400); if value < min || value > max, return jsonResponse({ error: `${label} must be between ${min} and ${max}` }, 400); otherwise return null

rationale.chosen_approach: Centralized module avoids duplicating validation logic across 11+ files; single source of truth for limits and patterns; follows chat.ts guard-return HttpResponse | null pattern
decision_factors: DRY principle — same validation repeated across 11 files
Auditability — one file to review for security policy
chat.ts existing pattern proves the approach works

risks.risk: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot path containment check may be too strict on Windows with case-insensitive paths
risks.mitigation: Use path.normalize on both sides before comparison; Windows path.resolve handles drive letters correctly
